## About
Westlake Massage is a professional massage studio in Austin. Our holistic approach is designed to care for your mind, body, and soul, with personalized treatments from a staff dedicated to helping you feel rejuvenated.
Reviewers often name the therapist they saw. One reviewer said Lindsey took the time to ask what she was looking for and checked in on strength and depth throughout. Another called Mary Ellen one of the best therapists she has had, and a third enjoyed Alison. We're rated 4.6 from 45 Google reviews.
You'll find us on Bee Cave Rd, not too far from Barton Creek Mall. You'll check in downstairs, and the massage studios are upstairs.

## Services
- Deep Tissue: Rejuvenating and stress relieving, for total relaxation.
- The Athelete: A sports-inspired massage that stimulates the lymphatic and circulatory systems and improves range of motion.
- Swedish: Calming, and meant to ease emotional stress.
- 60 minutes: Choose Deep Tissue, The Athelete or Swedish. ($210.00)
- 90 minutes: The same choices, with more time to unwind. ($280.00)
- Heat Therapy: An upgrade with hot towels on the neck and back during your treatment. (+$30)
- Cupping: An upgrade with cups placed to soften muscles and open lymphatic pathways. (+$50)
- CBD Lotion Therapy: An upgrade using CBD infused cream for deeper physical relief. (+$35)

## FAQ
Q: Which massage styles can I choose from?
A: You can choose Deep Tissue, The Athelete or Swedish.

Q: Where do I go when I arrive?
A: You'll check in downstairs, and the massage studios are upstairs.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Saturday hours are 11:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
